title: Wan 2.1 VACE preprocessed-depth restyle
description: Local depth-conditioned video restyle. It requires a preprocessed grayscale depth video; the app checks dimensions, decoded frame count and every timestamp against the source. The graph does not estimate depth, and depth-to-scene semantic alignment remains the user's responsibility. Effect quality is unqualified.

evidence: Graph executed 2026-10-19 on ComfyUI 0.37.0 / RTX 4090: the exact template graph ran a 160x96, 16 FPS, 17-frame testsrc2 source with an aligned grayscale testsrc2 depth video to a 24,468-byte H.264 MP4 (SHA-256 df22aa5b986c7dd93bf5ba6a43a6a730ad9e4c8a0462c2433b31f94e479d91a6) in 9.0 s (prompt aa79567e-a8f4-4b76-beb3-719f9d7ae2b0), preserving 160x96, 16 FPS and 17 frames. This records output structure and hash evidence. The app now rejects mismatched dimensions, decoded frame count, timestamps and non-grayscale depth media before queueing. This establishes local graph execution and admission only; semantic depth alignment, effect quality, adherence, preservation, temporal consistency and platform behavior remain unqualified.

Fresh local graph execution 2026-10-22, prompt 526c79d6-ad05-4922-b6f9-4be01b66f562: cleared fictional jacket fixture produced 99794-byte H.264 MP4,832x480,16 FPS,17 frames,1.0625s,SHA-256 b7be43ba34d960e9014b63aa2e5f4b44a56f38ad49595820180aecdf818324a3. This records output structure and a recoloring example only. Seams,pockets and lettering changed; preservation,occlusion and broad temporal quality are unqualified.
